text:
maya: quick check — I'm about to apply a small TF change in staging to create a safelisted namespace + KSA + IRSA for the billing-exporter. Can someone eyeball the terraform and k8s snippets in the PR before I apply? planning to run at 21:00 UTC tonight :clock8: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4823

alex: pinging to review, thanks. which IAM role ARN are you attaching? want to confirm trust/no-overprivilege. also: is this using projected SA token or legacy token?

sam: quick look — it's using projected tokens (IRSA) per the annotation. snippet from the PR: 
```hcl
resource "aws_iam_role" "billing_exporter_role" {
  name = "redwood-billing-exporter-stg"
  assume_role_policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.eks_assume_role.json
}

resource "aws_iam_role_policy_attachment" "billing_exporter_s3" {
  role       = aws_iam_role.billing_exporter_role.name
  policy_arn = "arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonS3ReadOnlyAccess"
}
```

sam: and the service account in k8s manifest from the same PR: 
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: billing-exporter
  namespace: billing-staging
  annotations:
    eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-billing-exporter-stg
```

jordan: couple of quick notes — 1) add the projected token audience annotation if we need token validation: `eks.amazonaws.com/audience: sts.amazonaws.com` for STS audience in our setup? 2) confirm sts regional endpoint setting if the account expects that. 3) please add a tight IAM policy instead of full S3ReadOnly if we only need a prefix (we can limit to billing/*).

maya: thanks. on audience — we use the default `sts.amazonaws.com` for IRSA. I'll add the audience annotation and tighten the IAM policy scope.

alex: also remember the namespace safelist label — platform namespace controller requires `platform.safe=true` to allow cross-namespace imagepull secrets. Add this to the namespace manifest: 
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: billing-staging
  labels:
    platform.safe: "true"
```

maya: good catch. I'll update the PR. one more: will the helm release for billing-exporter be namespaced? the helm chart currently assumes `global.serviceAccount.create: false` so we are creating KSA separately.

sam: that's fine. Just ensure the helm values set `serviceAccount.name: billing-exporter` and `serviceAccount.create: false`.

jordan: last check — CI/plan output looks clean? deploy-bot — can you post the terraform plan summary?

deploy-bot: Terraform plan for branch feature/billing-ksa (staging):
- aws_iam_role.billing_exporter_role will be created
- aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.billing_exporter_s3 will be created
- kubernetes_namespace.billing_staging will be created (API)
- kubernetes_service_account.billing_exporter will be created (API)
Plan: 4 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy. 

maya: perfect. I'll make the policy narrower and add the annotations/label changes, update the PR, and then apply around 21:00 UTC if no objections. thanks all :raised_hands:

alex: ack. I'll take a quick pass on the final policy scope once updated.

sam: +1

jordan: +1

maya: applying now if green from CI — will post the apply output when done.
